jobs.title: Working Student Modeled Data
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Our Mission

As AI rapidly transforms how information is created and consumed, high-quality proprietary data is becoming the critical ingredient for generating trustworthy insights and enabling better decisions. Models become more powerful as the quality of the underlying data improves.

The mission of the Modeled Data department is to develop high-quality proprietary data at scale, empowering our customers to make better business decisions with confidence.

To achieve this, we are building the next generation of proprietary data production: a standardized, AI-enabled production system that combines artificial intelligence and human expertise to deliver scalable, transparent, and high-quality outputs.

We believe the future is not AI instead of analysts, but AI together with analysts. AI excels at automating repetitive work, scaling production, and accelerating execution, while analysts contribute structured problem solving, statistical reasoning, domain expertise, and critical judgment. Together, they create outcomes that neither could achieve alone.

Our analysts therefore have a dual mission: they continuously deepen their expertise in business domains and statistical modeling while simultaneously helping build and improve the AI-powered production platform that will define the future of proprietary data.

 
 

Your Role

As a Working Student, you will support our analysts in building and maintaining proprietary data and contribute to improving our analytical workflows and production systems.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Support the analysis of structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources

  • Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preparing datasets for modeling and analysis

  • Help build and maintain Python-based analytical workflows and scripts

  • Support analysts in identifying trends, patterns, and key market insights

  • Assist in improving data pipelines, methodologies, and documentation

  • Contribute to ongoing projects that aim to make our data production more scalable and efficient

 
 

Your Profile

  • Enrolled student at a university (mandatory)

  • Field of study in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (preferred)

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills

  • Basic experience with Python (e.g., through coursework, projects, or internships)

  • Interest in data, markets, and business dynamics

  • Ability to work independently and in a structured way

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (English required, German is a plus)

 

Nice to have

  • Experience with SQL or databases

  • Familiarity with data analysis or visualization tools

  • Exposure to statistical methods or market research

  • Interest in AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot)

 
 

Your Team

You will be part of an international, data-driven team working on analytical projects across different markets and industries. You will support real modeling and data production work while gaining hands-on experience with data, tools, and methodologies.

 

This role offers the opportunity to learn how proprietary data is built at scale and how analytical workflows can be combined with AI to create scalable data products.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

jobs.description:
Über uns – Talentspring Academy Group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss, während gleichzeitig ganze Branchen durch KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle transformiert werden. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Die Talentspring Academy Group baut eine neue Generation von Bildungsplattformen für die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Wir qualifizieren Arbeitssuchende, Quereinsteiger:innen und Beschäftigte für gefragte Tätigkeiten in Bereichen wie Online Marketing, Digital Sales und Künstliche Intelligenz.

Mit unserem hybriden Modell aus digitaler Plattform und physischer Infrastruktur – über 900 Standorte bundesweit durch unseren Partner Studienkreis – schaffen wir eine neue Kategorie im deutschen Weiterbildungsmarkt.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?


Über die Rolle

Als Praktikant Business Building & AI Automation baust du die internen Systeme, mit denen unsere Organisation skaliert: Tools, Datenstrecken und Automatisierungen, die Arbeit übernehmen, die heute noch Menschen erledigen.

Du arbeitest im Venture-Building-Team und berichtest direkt an unseren CEO. Wir sind builders within: ein Team, das im Unternehmen selbst baut – interne Produkte, Systeme und neue Geschäftsmodelle – statt Konzepte für andere zu schreiben. Du kommst also nicht als einzelne Automatisierungskraft in eine Fachabteilung, sondern in eine Gruppe, die dasselbe Handwerk betreibt wie du.

Unsere Sales-Organisation umfasst aktuell 30 Personen und wächst schnell. Parallel entwickeln wir eine HubSpot-basierte CRM-Architektur, neue B2B-Strukturen und eine datengetriebene Marketing- und Sales Engine. Genau in diesem Umbau setzt deine Arbeit an.

Eng zusammen arbeitest du mit Infrastruktur & Data. Die Rolle liegt an der Schnittstelle von:

  • Marketing und Sales
  • Operations und Akademie
  • CRM und Tech Stack
  • Data und Analytics
  • Venture Building und neue Geschäftsmodelle

Kurz gesagt: Du baust an unserem internen Betriebssystem – und setzt selbst um, was du entworfen hast. Für reine Strategie- oder Analystenarbeit ist die Rolle nicht gedacht: Hier wird gebaut, eingeführt und gemessen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Process Intelligence & Automation: Du durchleuchtest Abläufe in Marketing, Sales, Operations und Akademie, bewertest sie nach Aufwand, Häufigkeit und wirtschaftlichem Hebel und automatisierst die Prozesse mit dem größten Effekt.
  • Internal Tools & Rapid Prototyping: Du baust mit KI- und No-Code-Werkzeugen (z. B. n8n, KI-Agenten) interne Anwendungen und Prototypen, testest sie direkt im laufenden Betrieb und übernimmst Rollout, Dokumentation und Einweisung der Teams.
  • AI Workflows: Du bringst KI über den Prototypenstatus hinaus: Anfragen priorisieren, Gespräche auswerten, Chancen und Risiken erkennen, operative Arbeit übernehmen. Was funktioniert, wird zum verlässlichen internen Produkt.
  • Data, KPI & Reporting: Du führst Daten aus unseren Systemen zusammen, definierst Kennzahlen entlang der Growth Engine – von Leadgenerierung über Funnel bis Enrollment – und baust die Grundlagen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Management.
  • Build-vs-Buy & Tool Evaluation: Du bewertest neue Tools und Frameworks entlang von Kosten, Nutzen und Skalierbarkeit und gibst eine begründete Empfehlung: selbst bauen oder einkaufen.
  • Business Building Support: Du erarbeitest Datengrundlagen und Unit Economics für neue Geschäftsmodelle und Beteiligungen und lieferst damit die Basis für Go-/No-go-Entscheidungen.

Technologie ist dabei Mittel, nicht Ergebnis. Deine Arbeit soll uns mehr Anfragen bringen, die Abschlussquote erhöhen, Entscheidungswege verkürzen oder Wachstum ohne zusätzliche Verwaltung ermöglichen – messbar in Stunden, Kosten pro Vorgang und Durchlaufzeit.


Das bringst Du mit

Du bist ein Builder:Du siehst einen kaputten Prozess – und baust etwas Besseres.

  • Baustärke: Du hast schon mal etwas gebaut – ein Tool, eine Automatisierung, ein System.
  • Kaufmännisches & analytisches Denken: Du denkst in Kosten, Nutzen, Zahlen und Daten.
  • Tool-Affinität: Digitale Tools, CRM-Strukturen und Automatisierung sind dir vertraut.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Lieber eine erste Version live als die perfekte Theorie.
  • AI-Native Mindset: KI ist für dich Handwerkszeug, kein Spielzeug.
  • Studium: BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business o. Ä. – als Praktikum im Studium oder danach.
Kein Informatikstudium nötig – zeig uns einfach etwas, das du gebaut hast: ein Automatisierungs-Flow, ein GPT, ein Dashboard, ein Nebenprojekt.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit mit direktem Impact: Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Business Cases, sondern an Systemen, die echte Bildungschancen schneller erreichbar machen – mit direkter Wirkung auf Arbeitsmarktintegration und Fachkräftesicherung.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den Aufbau einer skalierenden Organisation – von CRM-Architektur über datengetriebene Steuerung bis zu moderner Growth- und KI-Infrastruktur.
  • Ein Profil, das danach gesucht wird: Du kannst ein Geschäftsmodell durch seine Daten lesen, Prozesskosten rechnen und ein System bauen und einführen. Diese Kombination öffnet Türen – im Venture Building, in der Beratung und in jeder operativen Führungsrolle.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung: Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in der Schublade. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung und arbeitest direkt mit Entscheider:innen.
  • Hybrid & Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Berliner Büro, mit klaren Strukturen, moderner digitaler Infrastruktur und einem Team, das auf Vertrauen, Ownership und Ergebnisse setzt.
  • Faire Vergütung & Perspektive: Leistungsbezogene Vergütung und bei überzeugender Leistung das Gespräch über eine Weiterbeschäftigung.
  • Teamspirit & Sparring: Fachliche Begleitung durch Kolleg:innen aus Infrastruktur, Data, Sales und Marketing, regelmäßiges Feedback und Zugang zu unseren eigenen Weiterbildungsangeboten.


Unser Bekenntnis zur Chancengleichheit

Wir bei der Talentspring Academy Group sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Die Talentspring Academy Group steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, dass jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt.

Many of our projects start with a concept or evaluation workshop: together with the decision makers we assess use cases and the data situation and turn vague ideas into a concrete project roadmap. We are currently building this workshop format into a consulting offering of its own, and we are looking for reinforcement.

Your role: strategic and technical consulting

As an AI Consultant you are the bridge between our ML scientists and the business units of our clients. You work in tandem with the Account Management and Business Development team and take the technical lead in workshops and pre-sales meetings.

In this position you are the face of dida for specific industries: you follow no rigid process, but develop innovative solutions together with our engineers and our clients.

Your tasks

  • Prepare and run workshops: You prepare client workshops and run them together with the team. Your part is the technical depth: assessing use cases, reviewing the data situation, judging feasibility and translating complex ML concepts into clear business cases.
  • Turn results into roadmaps: You translate workshop results into technical roadmaps and work with our ML teams on effort estimates and proposal content.
  • Work hands-on: You look at client data yourself and build clickable prototypes and small demos that make workshop results tangible right away.
  • Support business development: You bring in technical expertise, for example in discovery calls or on feasibility questions. Commercial responsibility for accounts, offers, pricing and negotiations stays with the sales team.
  • Develop our standards: You extend our workshop frameworks and templates that we reuse with every new client.


Your Profile

  • Education: A strong degree in a quantitative field, for example data science, computer science, mathematics, physics or engineering.

  • Hands-on mentality: You try things out directly and enjoy building a first prototype quickly.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.

  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.

  • Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich machen, Workshops und Meetings sicher führen und auch in herausfordernden Situationen Klarheit schaffen.
  • Du bist nah an der operativen Realität: Du willst verstehen, wie produzierende Unternehmen wirklich funktionieren, bist gerne direkt am Shopfloor unterwegs und weißt, dass wirksame Veränderung nicht nur am Schreibtisch entsteht.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry?

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.


That’s enough about us – what about you?

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

Position Summary:

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.


Key position responsibilities:

  • Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation

  • Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)

  • Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio

  • Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy

  • Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients

  • Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information

  • Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product

  • Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service

  • Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

  • Perform other special projects or duties when required


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Experience required:

  • Problem solving mindset

  • Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Good analytical skills with attention to detail

  • Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

  • Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

  • Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

    • Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

    • Program Development & Optimization:

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.
    • Why Join our Account Management Team:
     
    At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.

Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!


About the role

Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.

This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.

Here's how you'll make a difference

  • Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.

  • Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.

  • Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

  • Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days.

  • Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs.

  • Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report.

What makes you a great fit

  • You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track.

  • You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters.

  • You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem.

  • You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs.

  • You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust.

  • You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them.

  • You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used.

Nice to have

  • Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms.

  • Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization.

  • Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact.

What success looks like

  • 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery.

  • 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier.

  • 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve.

 

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you will play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value.

  • Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

  • Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

  • Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.
  • Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field

Benefits

In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

  • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
  • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
  • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
  • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
  • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
  • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
  • Experience with supplier quality management.
  • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
  • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
  • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
  • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Who You Are

You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

Customs Specialist (Europe)
jobs.description:
Location: Fully remote in Europe

Working Hours: Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our Mission 🎯

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

About the Role 🤔

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

What will you be doing? 😎

  • Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform

  • Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product

  • Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework

  • Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found

  • Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately

  • Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

  • Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane

  • Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping

  • Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)

  • Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically

  • Extensive US import-export experience is required.

  • Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume

  • Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy

  • Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook

  • Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams

  • A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)

  • Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics

  • Experience with Indian export processes

  • Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

Our culture and what we offer 😉

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits

🕰️ Flexible working and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets.

You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance

  • Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team

  • Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking

  • Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops

  • Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption

  • Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth

  • Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading

  • Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans

  • Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical

  • Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes

  • Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands

About you

  • You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins.

  • Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals.

  • Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first.

  • You have a track record of driving sales motions for high-ticket solutions where deal sizes are consistently in the hundreds of thousands, focusing on relationship-driven, consultative outcomes.

  • You have 3+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling Account Executives teams, with a clear track record of raising team performance, enforcing pipeline discipline, and driving revenue growth.

  • You have coached team members through long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

  • You have successfully built and scaled sales motions across multiple markets, driving high performance through rigorous CRM discipline, RevOps tooling, and predictable forecasting routines.

  • You excel at creating practical sales handbooks, enablement resources, playbooks, and coaching frameworks that teams rely on to drive complex, long-cycle enterprise deals.

  • You are a seasoned people leader who sets a high bar for excellence, fostering talent through direct feedback, clear performance management, and structured coaching.

  • You combine strong commercial judgment—knowing when to push or qualify out—with the executive presence to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders.

  • You have a builder mentality and are comfortable creating structure in an environment that is still scaling

  • You communicate excellently in English

Existing understanding of VC / PE fund operations, GP / LP structures, fund administration, investor onboarding, transfer agency, or Luxembourg fund structures is a strong plus.

What success looks like

In your first months, you will build a clear understanding of bunch’s commercial motion, ICP, product, implementation model, pricing, and market dynamics. You will establish trust with the existing sales team, founders, and key cross-functional partners, while introducing a clear cadence for pipeline reviews, deal coaching, forecasting, and performance visibility.

Over time, you will strengthen the team’s execution across priority markets, improve pipeline quality and forecast accuracy, standardise the sales playbook, support hiring and onboarding, and build stronger cross-functional routines with Marketing, Solutions, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and RevOps. You will also establish the core sales infrastructure the team needs to scale: clear funnel processes, reliable CRM workflows, useful dashboards, practical handbooks, repeatable coaching routines, and a shared source of truth for how we sell.

Ultimately, you will help build a high-performing and scalable sales organisation across UK, Luxembourg and Germany, improving predictable revenue generation and constantly raising the quality bar for complex private-markets selling.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) – Role deep dive, sales leadership, and commercial scope

  3. Sales Leadership Case (60 min) – Coaching, pipeline discipline, and complex deal execution

  4. Final Round (3 x 45 min) – Meet our leadership team (Tech, Ops, CS).

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members.

  6. Reference checks

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our Regulatory Legal team is the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken’s product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We’re a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice – partnering directly with Compliance, Product, and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served.

The Senior Counsel role is a remote role based in the UK or the EU, and will report into the EU/UK Regulatory Legal team. The role exists to own the significant volume of ongoing, business-as-usual regulatory work that currently falls to a small group of very senior lawyers – freeing them to focus on strategic licensing initiatives, complex transactions, and team leadership.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward’s growing offerings in the EU and UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under MiCA/EU or in the UK) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise.

We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK or EU.

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team’s active licensing applications and other in-flight EU/UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting EU/UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiCA and the UK Cryptoasset Regime, CBI and FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, DORA, outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations

 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor/Barrister, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State)

  • 10+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams

  • Direct experience supporting regulator engagement (e.g., with the CBI, FCA, or an equivalent EU competent authority), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence

  • Substantive experience advising on MiCA or the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026) — experience with one regime is sufficient; both is not required

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the EU or UK (experience in one jurisdiction is sufficient; both is not required), including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., Digital Operational Resilience Act in the EU, or the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime in the UK)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with MiFID II and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments

  • Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward’s and competitors’ products

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.

jobs.description:
Part-Time | Switzerland (Remote) | Global EOR & HR Platform | Employed via Swiss Entity

ABOUT THE CLIENT

Our client is a fast-growing global HR, payroll, and compliance platform operating across 180+ regions. The company combines technology with owned entities, in-house legal and payroll expertise, transparent pricing, and dedicated human support - helping businesses of all sizes hire talent anywhere in the world.

The company is driven by a constant pursuit of innovation, expanding its product suite to create integrated HR solutions for businesses from fledgling startups to global enterprises.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an HR & EOR Operations Manager to join our Swiss entity on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on operational role - not a purely administrative or advisory position.

As part of the role, you will serve as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under SECO/Zürich personnel leasing law, fulfilling a standing legal obligation tied to our EOR licence. This means you must be genuinely employed, operationally involved, and present in Switzerland - not an external adviser lending a name to a form.

Day-to-day workload is manageable within a 50% FTE, and you will be fully supported by the company's global HR, payroll and compliance teams. Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome, provided they do not interfere with your availability and supervision of the entity's activities.

This role is a strong fit for HR or EOR professionals already freelancing, holding consulting mandates, or looking to add a substantive part-time role to their portfolio.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Act as the named Responsible Person for the Swiss entity under Swiss personnel leasing (SECO) law.

  • Ensure compliance with Swiss labour-leasing legislation, Swiss employment law, and the staffing industry GAV (minimum wages and equal treatment).

  • Maintain documentation required for SECO and cantonal audits and inspections.

  • Serve as the primary Swiss contact for SECO and cantonal authorities.

  • Oversee HR and employment operations for the Swiss entity - including onboarding, contract controls, and employment matters.

  • Support payroll oversight in collaboration with the global payroll team.

  • Handle employee and client escalations related to HR and compliance matters.

  • Supervise the entity's EOR/personnel leasing activities and ensure they are conducted properly.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Right to Work in Switzerland - one of the following is required:

  • Swiss citizen.

  • EU/EFTA national with a current Swiss B or C permit.

  • Non-EU/EFTA national with a Swiss C permit (a non-EU/EFTA B permit alone does not qualify).

  • EU/EFTA national with a genuine 5-year cross-border G permit.

Education:

Any completed qualification - EFZ apprenticeship, Matura/Abitur, or university degree in any field.

Experience - either route qualifies:

Standard route:

3+ years in one of the following: recruitment or placement, personnel leasing or staffing (including EOR), substantive HR (not admin-only), personnel consulting, or organisational/business consulting. Employment certificates confirming dates, workload percentage and substantive duties are required alongside a CV.

Alternative route:

3+ years of general professional experience plus a completed, recognised HR qualification with a passed exam (e.g. HRSE or VSH HR Assistant). Course attendance without a final certificate does not count.

Character:

Clean criminal record, debt-enforcement register and tax history.

Other:

  • Comfortable being named on the Commercial Register with signing authority.

  • Willing to disclose other jobs, board mandates or licensed-business responsibilities.

  • Genuinely hands-on - purely advisory profiles (external lawyers or accountants with no operational involvement) are not suitable.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a rare opportunity for an experienced HR or EOR professional in Switzerland to take on a meaningful operational role at a global scale without committing to a full-time position.

You will hold a real and recognised legal position within the Swiss entity, with direct contact with SECO and cantonal authorities, while being backed by an experienced international HR, payroll and compliance team.

The 50% structure makes this accessible to consultants, freelancers and professionals looking to add a substantive part-time engagement alongside existing work. International EOR or HR experience is fully valid - experience does not need to be Swiss-based, though familiarity with Swiss employment law and social insurance is an advantage.

The company values a builder mentality - people who want to improve processes, not just maintain them.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

  • Fully remote within Switzerland.

  • Part-time 50% FTE with flexible hours.

  • Direct collaboration with the global HR, payroll and compliance teams.

  • Meaningful presence in Switzerland required (~50% benchmark) - remote-only offshore oversight does not meet regulatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Health insurance contributions.

  • Share incentives.

  • Learning and mentorship opportunities.

  • Team offsites and social events.

  • 4 weeks of work-from-anywhere per year.

  • Other concurrent work or mandates are welcome.

  • Experience in cross functional collaborations and contributions to building highly functional commercial teams

Key Responsibilities:

  • Break into and drive large, complex deals through lead to close. Experience navigating large company procurement processes.

Senior Product Manager – Consumer Lifecycle

Location: London, United Kingdom 

Employment type: Permanent, full-time, Office first

Team description

The Consumer Lifecycle team owns the product experience that turns SumUp app signups into active, transacting customers - from onboarding through to first transaction and ongoing engagement.  As the sole Product Manager for consumer activation and engagement, you  will own that funnel end to end, improving conversion at every stage. 

What you'll do

  • Own the consumer onboarding funnel end to end: signup, identity verification (KYC), first funding, first transaction and habitual use
  • Identify and ship product improvements at the biggest drop-off points, starting with the gap between KYC completion and first transaction
  • Balance fraud and verification controls with a smooth, user-friendly product experience
  • Run discovery, experimentation and iteration cycles against activation targets, and report progress to consumer leadership

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience leading a consumer product area with clear commercial and KPI accountability
  • Strong track record of prioritising effectively across competing demands from multiple teams and stakeholders
  • Experience driving engagement or retention within a consumer-facing mobile app used at scale
  • Comfort balancing risk or compliance requirements against a smooth, user-friendly product experience
  • Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, design, data and marketing, and communicate progress clearly to leadership

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our London Bridge location. This role
  • involves an office-first setup
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

 

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.
