Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we are building the world's first clinical trial platform to create greater visibility, access, and engagement across a more diverse population of doctors and their patients.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor: we enable global pharmaceutical companies to confidently partner with community-based researchers to increase patient access to the latest medical innovations. Our AI-powered platform currently offers clinical trials from leading companies to over 5,500 sites across the globe and we are well poised for growth in 2026.

We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is the recent recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Hands-on professional experience on LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.), 1 year in a production environment (not a pet project)

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Experience implementing and deploying AI-based features in production

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

Bonus

  • you reconverted from software engineering

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

💊 Benefits:

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer, Product to own how data moves from Inato's platform into the hands of the people who depend on it — our product squads, CS and Marketing teams, sponsors, and sites. You'll enable trusted self-service at scale, prove the value of our new product offerings faster, and ship data products directly into the user experience.

You'll report to Alexandre Halley (Data Director) and partner daily with Product squads (PMs, engineers, designers), with regular touchpoints into CS, Marketing, and Sponsor / Site Ops.

Our stack includes Segment, Airbyte, Dagster, BigQuery, dbt, Hex, FullStory, and more.

What you'll own

  • Trusted self-service at scale. Own metric definitions, build the semantic layer powering our AI-driven self-service in Hex, and govern what gets exposed so non-data teams can answer their own questions confidently.

  • Faster value validation for new offerings. Partner with squads to translate vague operational pains (a CS workflow, a sponsor enablement gap, a prototype idea) into working data assets in days — from real-data prototype to production-grade pipeline.

  • Data products in front of users. Own the tables consumed by the product itself, and the user-facing dashboards (embeds, custom interfaces) that sponsors, sites, and internal teams rely on day to day.

  • Using AI to scale yourself and the team. Automate the parts of data work that don't need a human in the loop so the team can keep pace as new offerings multiply and Inato grows. The data team is pioneering AI-enablement internally, and this role is at the front of that.

What success looks like

  • By 3 months: You own at least one new-offering data pipeline end-to-end. Corresponding data points are available for self-service, and new metric definitions are live. You've automated at least one internal process using AI.

  • By 6 months: At least three user-facing dashboards or data streams are live.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 4+ years as an Analytics Engineer, or in a hybrid data engineer/analyst role with strong analytics engineering ownership.

  • Strong dbt + warehouse modeling skills (we use BigQuery).

  • Track record of owning data products end-to-end: definition → ship → measurable adoption.

  • A genuine product mindset — you start from the user's problem, not from the SQL.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with non-data stakeholders.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity — you can turn a vague operational pain into a working data asset without a fully-specified ticket.

Nice-to-have

  • Fluency with AI-assisted tooling (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Hex AI) and a habit of using it to ship faster.

  • Experience building production-grade company dashboards.

  • Domain exposure to healthcare, clinical trials, or other regulated industries.

Working style

You're impact-driven and pragmatic — you instinctively reach for the shortest path to the user's need. You're systematic: you'd rather improve the system than re-fix the same symptom. You're satisfied shipping the 80% solution at 20% of the effort, then iterating on it. You're equally comfortable in a stakeholder conversation, a dbt PR, and a quick prototype.

You'll thrive here if your career arc looks something like: started as an analyst or PM, moved up the stack toward analytics engineering or data product, have lived in start-ups or scale-ups where you owned a meaningful slice of the data value chain end-to-end, and have shipped complex projects with measurable end-user value.

Location and Compensation

  • France-based, remote-first. Office available in Grands Boulevards, Paris if you want to use it.

  • Base salary range: 65,000€ – 80,000€, plus equity. No individual variable bonus.

Why this role, why now

Inato is in a phase of rapid growth driven by new product offerings, and the data team is one of the functions directly responsible for proving and scaling that value. You'll have a direct line to the VP Product, real ownership from day one, and a small senior team around you. Inato is leaning hard into AI-enablement, and the data team is pioneering it internally — there's a clear path to Lead or Staff Analytics engineer, or Data Product Manager within 2–3 years as our data-as-a-product surface grows.

Perks

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Amazing office in Grands Boulevards, Paris where you can meet with colleagues if this is important for you

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by over $55 million from top-tier investors like Sequoia Capital, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

An AI agent that runs a property transaction end to end only works if the data underneath it is available, reliable and governed. That is the job.

Why this role exists

This is the first dedicated data hire in years. The foundations run, the steering is up to you.

While BigQuery already houses most of our data, we still lack key Growth data and a cohesive data governance framework. We need unified definitions, a canonical schema, and a robust semantic layer, enabling Growth, Finance, Ops and Product to self-serve insights efficiently and reliably.

Today the stack holds because individuals across Ops, Growth, Finance and Engineering compensate locally. They learned the quirks and built workarounds. It works, but it is fragile: KPIs drift between tools, tracking breaks silently, costs escalate, and nobody owns the translation between raw engineering data and decision-ready truth.

You will be the single accountable owner of that layer. Not a support function, not a ticketing desk, not a BI factory.

What you will own

Canonical models and metric definitions. A documented semantic layer with canonical entities (Buyer, Seller, Asset, Agent) and Bronze / Silver / Gold layers. Clear contracts between what Engineering exposes and what each function consumes, so that KPI debates are aligned on the same metric.

Self-serve enablement. The submerged part of the iceberg: clean models, consistent BI primitives, row- and column-level security, so Ops, Growth, Finance and Account Managers build their own dashboards without compromising on accuracy.

Analytics and tracking governance. The global event taxonomy and tracking roadmap, a hybrid client-side and server-side event strategy, consistent sync across CRMs and marketing platforms, and GDPR consent flows by design, so acquisition spend runs on attribution we can trust.

Platform reliability, safety and cost. Standards set once rather than team by team: tested and versioned transformations, monitoring of freshness, failures and usage, sane ingestion patterns (read replicas, CDC, batch), and no production code path depending on BI tables.

Data and AI driving decisions. Our internal AI tooling already queries the data warehouse for analyses. What’s missing is the core foundation: standardized metric definitions, reusable logic, and pre-computed data models.

What success looks like after 12 months

  • One documented event taxonomy, actually used by Engineering, Growth and CRM.

  • One semantic layer where every shared KPI has a single definition, a single owner and a version history. New joiners understand the data model in days, not months.

  • Published freshness and failure SLAs, an explicit ingestion topology, and no production path depending on BI tables.

  • Ops, Growth, Finance and AMs build most of their recurring dashboards themselves, and AI agents query the data layer safely through curated MCPs.

  • Growth attribution is trustworthy enough that annual acquisition spend decisions are defensible end to end.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years as a Data, Analytics or Platform Engineer, ideally including a stint at a fast-moving consumer or marketplace company. Staff or Lead exposure expected.

  • Hands-on with the modern data stack: BigQuery (or Snowflake, Redshift), dbt or equivalent, advanced SQL and data modeling, Python for pipelines, orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).

  • You have shipped event tracking and instrumentation in production, end to end: taxonomy, client and server-side events, attribution, GDPR-compliant opt-out, propagation downstream.

  • Comfortable with ingestion patterns (Fivetran, Airbyte, CDC), reverse-ETL (Hightouch, Census, Segment), and access governance (IAM, row- and column-level security, PII tagging).

  • You have built and owned a semantic or metrics layer, and you can arbitrate metric definitions with Finance, Ops and Growth without flinching.

  • You treat AI agents as first-class data consumers: exposing data through MCPs, semantic APIs or text-to-SQL, with proper guardrails.

  • Strong ownership: you write the standards, defend them, and fix what is broken without waiting for permission.

  • A clear communicator who turns "ping the data person" rituals into self-serve handoffs.

  • Fluent in English and French.

The honest trade-off

There is no data team to manage, and none planned in the short term. You get real autonomy and a direct line to the founders and function leads, in exchange for building alone before maybe building a team. At a comparable proptech you would join an existing team and an existing roadmap. Here, what a metric means at Zefir is not decided yet, and you are the one who decides it.

It suits a doer’s mindset, including someone who has already led and wants to go back to building.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. If you’re excited about what we do and feel you could contribute, we want to hear from you.

About the company

The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition.

Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. Based in Paris, Lithosquare gathered an exceptional team of geologists, scientists, AI engineers, and data specialists to work as one, from field sampling to model optimization and push the boundaries of what's possible.

About the job

As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio.

This is a dynamic, cross-functional role: you will divide your time between field work (reconnaissance, sampling, drilling support) and office work in Paris, working closely with senior geologists, data scientists, and AI engineers. We are looking for someone rigorous, curious about technological innovation, and eager to learn while helping build the next generation of AI-assisted exploration tools.

What you'll do

Reporting to the Senior Geologists and the VP Asset Development, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Field Execution & Support: Support and participate in all phases of field exploration programs, including regional reconnaissance, surface sampling, geophysical surveys, and drilling campaigns. Assist with field logistics while ensuring compliance with international health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.

  • Data Compilation & QA/QC: Lead geological data entry, compilation, and QA/QC processes to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of exploration datasets across all projects.

  • Office Work: Assist senior geologists with geological data interpretation to support exploration targeting, field campaign planning, technical reporting, GIS mapping, data management, and project evaluation. Contribute to the preparation of maps, presentations, and technical documentation.

  • Bridge Geology & AI Tech: Work closely with the tech and AI teams to test, refine, and improve Lithosquare’s AI platform, ensuring our digital tools reflect field realities and technical needs.

  • Reporting & Collaboration: Prepare clear technical summaries, data visualizations, and maps for internal reviews and partner updates.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in mineral exploration geology

  • Degree in Geology or Earth Sciences, with solid foundations in metallogeny, structural geology, or geochemistry

  • First significant field exposure (mapping, sampling, or core logging) with a willingness to spend significant time in the field as required by projects

  • Data-driven & Rigorous: A structured approach to data management, QA/QC, and documentation; familiarity with GIS software (QGIS, ArcGIS) and/or geological modeling software is a plus

  • Tech-curious & Innovative mindset: Genuine interest in how AI and technology can transform traditional exploration methods

  • Strong Communication: Ability to collaborate effectively in a multi-disciplinary team (geologists, data scientists, AI engineers), interact professionally with partners and produce clear, synthetic & high-quality deliverables

  • Mission-driven: Passionate about the energy transition and solving complex physical-world challenges through innovation

  • Fluency in English is required with previous exposure to international exchanges

  • Valid Driver's License (Permis B) is a bonus

Perks & Benefits

  • 🏢 Offices located in the heart of Paris

  • 🌱 Strong culture of ownership & entrepreneurship

  • 🌍 Opportunity to significantly contribute to energy transition

  • 👥 Collaborative work environment with world-class experts in geology, AI, and data science

  • 🔄 Flexible work arrangements enabling work-life balance

  • 🚴 Sustainable mobility allowance (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

  • 🏋️ Gym pass

  • 🎉 Frequent team drinks, events & regular off-sites

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🍽️ Meal vouchers and health insurance coverage (Alan)

jobs.title: Legal Counsel – Commercial Contracts
jobs.description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out.

These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out.

  • Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence.

  • Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized.

  • Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine.

  • Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order.

  • Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion.

  • Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you.

  • Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis.

What You Bring to The Table:

  • Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results.

  • Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text.

  • Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records.

  • A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second.

  • A positive attitude and a passion for sales.

  • Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required.

Technical Must Have’s:

  • We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater (https://chromium.github.io/octane/).

  • A backup system for power and internet.

  • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day.

Compensation:

  • Base pay

  • 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue.

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance.

Schedule:

  • Full time (35-45 hrs per week)

  • Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT

  • Must be available to work weekends

Department

Outbound Sales

Locations

Multiple locations

Remote status

Fully Remote

jobs.description:
Join the Frontline of Health Innovation at Sun Coast Sciences

At Sun Coast Sciences, we’re on a mission to help people feel, think, and live better — through science. As an Appointment Setting Representative, you’ll be the first point of contact for individuals exploring our wellness solutions. Your voice will spark interest, build trust, and set the stage for impactful conversations with our senior sales team.

If you’re proactive, personable, and excited about connecting people to life-changing skin care solutions, this is the role for you.

Schedule:

Room to Grow

jobs.title: Protocol Review Specialist
jobs.description:
Transform Lives. Earn Unlimited. Work Remote.

As a Protocol Review Specialist, you'll conduct 20-minute consultative appointments with customers who've purchased our skin care and wellness products. Your mission? Guide them through personalized protocols that optimize their results, and their lives.

The Role:

You'll walk customers step-by-step through science-backed wellness protocols tailored to the products they've purchased. Using our proven permission-based selling approach, you'll identify when customers could benefit from additional supplements, products, or devices to support their beauty goals.

This process generates a sale on 30%-40% of the appointments, with an average order value somewhere around 2X what the customer spent online. So reps can sell anywhere from $500 to $1,000 every day, depending on their skill level and commitment to excellence.

Our Protocol Review Specialists enjoy a calendar full of scheduled appointments, a beautifully designed and lightning fast CRM and Phone System, and the fulfilling work of helping people live their healthiest life.

If any or all of this resonates with you, and you want to join our rapidly growing and THRIVING team of Protocol Review Specialists, we want to meet you.

What We're Looking For:

Non-Negotiables:

  • Genuine passion for skincare, health and wellness - you'll live and breathe this topic daily

  • Fluent English speaker - exceptional verbal and written communication skills are essential

  • Commitment to full-time work - 40 hours/week, usually Monday-Friday 9am-5:30pm CST with weekend appointments for added earning potential

  • Commission-driven mindset - motivated by performance-based unlimited earning potential

Technical Requirements:

  • Stable high speed internet (40 Mbps+ upload and 40 Mbps+ download required https://www.speedtest.net/)

  • Processing power and internet stability (Octane Speed 20,000+: https://chromium.github.io/octane/)

  • Backup system for power/internet outages (i.e. dedicated hotspot and power bank to last the entire day)

  • Reliable computer with working mic, camera, and noise-cancelling headset (Zoom-ready)

Ideal Candidate:

  • Self-starter who thrives on growth and sales excellence

  • Background in skincare/health/wellness or sales is a plus, but hunger to learn matters most

  • Natural relationship-builder who connects authentically with customers

  • Embodies integrity, drive, and Sun Coast Sciences’ core values

Compensation - Pay vs Draw:

  • Hourly draw or 15% commissions on Net Sales (Gross Sales minus Refunds)

  • You earn whichever is greater: draw or commission

Schedule

  • Typically Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST

  • Additional weekend appointments are available to increase earning potential


Ready to turn your wellness passion into serious income?

If you're driven to help customers transform their appearance while building an unlimited income remotely, we want to meet you.
Pay versus draw compensation model to help you ramp up

Apply today and join our rapidly growing team of top performers.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (Spain)
jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

  • Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders
  • Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape
  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise
  • Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities
  • Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations
  • You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations
  • You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions
  • Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations
  • You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation
  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones
  • Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents
  • Regular team meetups and annual retreats
  • Clear career progression path without requiring a management track
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

  • Working with top 1% SaaS experts
  • Supportive and empathetic leadership
  • End-to-end control with no account manager involvement
  • Highly data-driven and results-oriented
  • Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours
  • Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks
  • Regular professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
Ready to own paid media strategy for some of the fastest-growing B2B companies?

If you can run a Google Ads account (LinkedIn and Meta, too) with precision, and guide conversations with conviction, composure and confidence, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for a Paid Media Strategist who can lead senior client conversations, turn campaign complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B companies unstoppable, doing work we love, with people we like, how we want. We are a global, fully remote team across 8+ countries.

We have a talented and diverse team that live by our core values:

  • Always be in it to win it.
  • Give a shit.
  • Be obsessed with serving others.
  • Practice a growth mindset.
  • When we fail, don’t lose the lesson.
 

The opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B companies, you'll join a high performing team rated 4.8/5 on Glassdoor, where 95% of team members recommend us. This is a client-facing strategic paid media role. You won't just build campaigns or ship reports. You will lead calls, set the agenda, guide clients toward decisions, and connect every dollar of spend to pipeline and revenue.

What sets you apart
  • You lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • You keep control of a call: set the agenda, handle pushback thoughtfully in the moment, land on decisions and next steps
  • You report on the metrics the client's business runs on (demos, pipeline, revenue), never vanity metrics
  • You translate campaign data into plain-language recommendations a CMO can act on
  • You come to every conversation with a recommendation, not just a list of options
  • You spot risks, opportunities, and blockers before the client has to ask
  • You can deliver honest, sometimes difficult feedback in a way clients trust
  • You respectfully coach up and teach clients at multiple levels, from Marketing Managers to CMOs

Key responsibilities


Strategic Leadership

  • Develop paid media strategies aligned to each client's business goals and North Star Metric
  • Own forecasting and budget pacing against quarterly and annual targets
  • Lead monthly and quarterly reviews with senior stakeholders: results, tradeoffs, risks, next actions
  • Steer client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive AI-assisted campaign strategy, creative testing, and measurement

Client Success

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 4-7 B2B clients as their primary strategic contact
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand gen, and executive stakeholders
  • Run calls with confidence: set agendas, control the room, handle hard questions live
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations before the client asks
  • Own follow-through so every conversation ends with clear actions, owners, and timelines

Technical Excellence

  • Plan, launch, and optimize across Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, and Meta Ads
  • Own conversion tracking integrity end to end (GA4, GTM, CRM); never launch without it
  • Diagnose performance issues at the root: tracking, structure, bidding, creative, or demand
  • Prioritize by business impact, effort, and implementation reality; QA everything before it ships

Required experience

  • 3+ years hands-on B2B paid media, with at least 1 year in B2B SaaS
  • Prior client-facing strategy role where you owned communication, not just execution
  • Track record hitting MQL, SQL, or pipeline targets for B2B clients
  • Direct responsibility for at least $50k in monthly ad spend across multiple accounts
  • Google Ads depth plus at least one of LinkedIn, Meta, or Microsoft Ads
  • Working command of GA4, GTM, and CRM attribution (HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Written and spoken communication skills strong enough to lead senior calls and defend recommendations under pressure


Perks & Benefits:

  • This role is fully remote
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • We offer competitive compensation plus quarterly bonuses
  • Flexible working hours (requires 4 overlap hours with 9am - 5pm EST)
  • Paid training (school, events, conferences)
  • *For full-time Canadian residents only - comprehensive health, dental, and eye care

This role may not be a fit if

  • You prefer optimizing accounts without leading the client relationship

jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace — the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role — if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

  • Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

  • Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

  • Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

  • Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

  • Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

  • Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

  • Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection

  • A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

  • Availability to work US working hours

  • Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

  • Initiative & Persistence — You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

  • Ownership — The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them — even outside your immediate area — and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.

  • Customer-Centric — You feel your customers' situations genuinely and care about improving their lives, not just hitting a number. Talking to customers and solving their problems isn't a task on your list — it's the job.

  • Humble — You're low ego and care about getting to the best outcome, not about being right. You readily admit when you don't know something, you actively seek out feedback, and you're always looking to become a better version of yourself.

Benefits

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Estimated annual compensation: $12,000–$15,600 USD. Each candidate's compensation offer within this range will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

We are a team of hard-working marketers running a Premier Google Partner ad agency.

We help businesses large and small. Most of our clients are located in the United States, and our team members are located throughout the United States and around the world.

Check out our website: stubgroup.com

What we're looking for

We need a Senior Google Ads Account Manager! This is a remote (work-from-home) position.

Senior Google Ads Account Managers should possess:

  1. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads and how to create and manage profitable campaigns for ecommerce and lead-generation businesses.

  2. Strong client communication skills.

You will work directly with high-value clients as their primary point of contact and will be responsible for managing client relationships and creating and managing Google Ads campaigns for them.

Compensation & growth opportunities

At StubGroup, we have a milestone-based compensation structure that rewards our team members with increasing compensation as they generate more value for the company.

Starting Compensation: New Senior Google Ads Account Managers begin with a competitive monthly salary range of $4,000 - $5,000.

Bonuses and Incentives: Senior Google Ads Account Managers who go above and beyond may also earn additional bonuses and incentives aligned with the exceptional value they create for StubGroup.

Marketing Strategy: Your responsibility is to learn about each client's business, including their products, target audience, and more. Your goal is to guide clients toward strategies that maximize the profitability of their ad campaigns. jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

 

A look into the day to day:

  • Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you’ll be great at this!)
  • Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
  • Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day

 

We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.

 

Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

What You'll Do

  • Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.
  • Validate with real customers and iterate: Test your approaches with real patients, providers, and partners. Use what you learn to improve how we serve them — before issues become patterns.
  • Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.

 

In this job, you will:

  • Build strong relationships with Bask’s customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals
  • Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients
  • Manage all current customer data
  • Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
  • Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall
  • Work Weekends

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, or Customer Success at a SaaS organization
  • Experience in e-commerce
  • Experience with large- to enterprise-sized customer book of business
  • Creative problem solver with a determination to succeed
  • Independent and motivated, with the wisdom to seek help where needed
  • An entrepreneur
  • Highly articulate, ability to communicate effectively both when speaking and writing
  • Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with different teams (product, sales, marketing, etc.)

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.
